recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not normalize the display unit to mmol/L for this issue unless a new work-group decision supersedes the 2015 local-display-versus-UCUM-code resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-7237 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from the 2015May ballot for FHIR-core Observation. It reported errors in the generated narrative for the Base excess Observation example, including use of the abnormal/non-numeric interpretation for a numeric result, injection-related content, and lower-case display units beside UCUM codes; the final resolution pointed to #270 and clarified local Quantity display units versus standard UCUM codes.
initial_application: Commit 474be19befc8b8882da2b23a826dd0e2106a1538 explicitly listed 7237 and 7210 in its message, changed observation-example-f002-excess from interpretation A / abnormal non-numeric to H / above high normal, and removed the injection/body-site details. Later maintenance updated the display to High and the interpretation system URL without reintroducing the reported problem.
additional_context: FHIR-7210 is the fuller duplicate/supporting 2015May core #270 report for the same f002 example and is cited by the FHIR-7237 resolution. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and list/header source files still publish f002 as the Base Excess example. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/observation/observation-example-f002-excess.xml uses value 12.6 with interpretation H / High, has no injection/body-site content, and represents Quantity.unit as mmol/l with Quantity.code as mmol/L for the value and reference range, matching the resolution.
